status: planning evidence; not a finalized or validated implementation contract
user_decisions: Build the whole feature, including local clip library and automatic reels.
Keep GPU Screen Recorder as the main backend; prove and harden isolation first.
Native Omarchy integration first: the primary game surface is the Omarchy web app already opened by the plugin.

coverage.reason: The existing native QML panel gains capture controls and a separate clip library using the existing appearance tokens.
The owned helper persists clips, favorites, trim ranges, reel drafts, jobs, retention and migrations.
The game document crosses an extension/native-host boundary; automatic capture must exclude unrelated windows and audio.
The bridge maps browser presentation time to helper monotonic time and handles reconnects, duplicate markers and session expiry.
GSR replay IPC, Wayland portal source selection, PipeWire audio and Chromium app-mode behavior require real target proof.
The QML library adds playback, trimming, search and dialogs with keyboard, focus, text-state and scaling requirements.
Synthetic media, subprocess failures, real native capture, hosted gameplay and packaged installation need distinct evidence.
Recorder IPC, native messaging and clip playback must follow supported implementations, not inferred commands.

verified_local_baseline.limits: Package presence and documentation only. No capture, app-mode bridge, Ibara inventory, gameplay overhead or audio-isolation proof was performed during planning.

verified_candidates.name: GPU Screen Recorder replay mode
verified_candidates.ownership: GSR owns capture/encoding/buffer; the helper owns lifecycle, interval selection and saved-file validation.
verified_candidates.reason: Already used by the desktop helper and explicitly selected by Tyler.
verified_candidates.constraint: Portal capture does not alone guarantee a game window; prove restriction and selection before automatic saves.

verified_candidates.name: Chromium tabCapture with offscreen document
verified_candidates.reason: Tab/audio isolation is attractive, but needs a browser user gesture and a separate recording implementation; toolbar-led capture conflicts with native Omarchy app-first operation.

verified_candidates.name: OBS replay buffer
verified_candidates.verdict: not selected; comparison remains to verify in final dependency record
verified_candidates.reason: Would add another recorder/controller despite the user's GSR selection. No OBS capability is claimed as verified in this preflight.

verified_candidates.name: MV3 connector plus native messaging
verified_candidates.reason: Immediate messages without a local HTTP listener; explicit extension allowlist and native framing.
verified_candidates.constraint: Must prove app-mode injection and installation in Omarchy's actual supported browser/profile. Native messaging is unavailable directly in the game page/content script.

verified_candidates.name: Authenticated loopback HTTP or WebSocket
verified_candidates.reason: Requires a browser local-network/mixed-content/permission contract and exposed local server. No assumption that HTTPS can freely control localhost.

verified_candidates.name: Existing Qt Quick controls and Qt Multimedia
verified_candidates.reason: Preserves native plugin integration and both existing appearance modes. Installed Qt Multimedia supports the proposed media-player API; real codec playback remains to prove.

verified_candidates.name: External player and file manager only
verified_candidates.reason: Useful Reveal/Open actions, but does not satisfy a complete integrated library, trimming or reel workflow.

verified_candidates.name: Python sqlite3 with one helper writer
verified_candidates.reason: Standard-library transaction support for bounded metadata and jobs; no new database service.
verified_candidates.constraint: Read official transaction/migration documentation and test crash boundaries before finalization.

verified_candidates.name: One mutable JSON catalog
verified_candidates.reason: Would complicate transactional job state and concurrent library actions as the catalog grows.

verified_candidates.name: FFmpeg and ffprobe subprocesses
verified_candidates.reason: Already installed; supported filtering handles selected-clip normalization and synchronized concatenation.
verified_candidates.constraint: Record exact build/codec licensing and capabilities; use argument arrays, bounded queues and atomic output.
